events.name: Los Lobos
events.searchText: los lobos 94 7 kumu presents los lobos formed in 1973 in los angeles los lobos began as a traditional mexican folk group before fusing their sound with l a s punk and college rock scenes the core lineup david hidalgo louie perez cesar rosas conrad lozano and former blasters saxophonist steve berlin gained critical acclaim with their 1984 debut how will the wolf survive tying bruce springsteen as rolling stone s artist of the year they achieved global commercial stardom in 1987 with their chart topping cover of ritchie valens la bamba rather than coasting on pop fame the multi grammy winning band embraced a genre defying career pivoting to traditional tejano mariachi tributes la pistola y el corazon critically acclaimed experimental rock kiko film soundtracks desperado and their 2022 grammy winning homage to l a native sons now over 50 years into their career los lobos remains a legendary american act celebrated for seamlessly blending norteno tejano rock punk blues and soul into a sound all their own tickets 65 85 club policies show 7pm doors 5pm seating is first come first served per section 20 minimum per person full bar dinner menu available no refunds or exchanges tickets will be delivered 48 hours prior to the showtime please ensure you purchase tickets for the correct date and time when all available bar seats are occupied the remaining bar area is standing room only table seating is all ages bar area is 21 important note we are not affiliated with any third party ticket sellers tickets purchased directly through our official website or ticketweb are the only authorized sources group reservations groups of 6 or more that want to sit together must purchase a group package at events bluenotehawaii com parking validated parking available at outrigger paradise entrance located on kuhio ave 6 for up to 4 hours of parking blue note hawaii honolulu hi us los lobos

events.name: MELVIN TAYLOR Returns to FITZGERALDS Nightclub
events.searchText: melvin taylor returns to fitzgeralds nightclub fitzgeralds nightclub presents melvin taylor returns to fitzgeralds nightclub 20 general admission reserved tables available with shows that sell out all over the world melvin taylor is one of the greatest guitarists in the history of rock blues and jazz he is often referred to as a guitar players guitarist this self taught master was influenced by many of history s true guitar pioneers including albert king jimmy reed wes montgomery and jimi hendrix he has appeared on the same ticket with stevie ray vaughan carlos santana george benson buddy guy and bb king melvin taylor was born in 1959 in jackson mississippi his musical roots however have always been in chicago where he moved with his family when he was 3 years old the proverbial musical prodigy started playing guitar at age 6 melvin was influenced and inspired by some of the world s greatest blues players many of whom lived in or near his chicago neighborhood by the age of twelve he was working in clubs he taught himself slide playing finger picking and flat picking styles from listening to his favorite artists by the time he was a teenager melvin s incredible ability and unique style was already grabbing attention on maxwell street in 1980 he joined veterans pinetop perkins and willie rdquo big eyes smith of the muddy waters band to form the legendary blues band and tour europe melvin made an immediate impact on the european circuit and while in france he cut his first two albums blues on the run 1982 and plays the blues for you 1984 following his return to the us melvin recorded four additional cd s for evidence music bang that bell 1999 dirty pool 2002 melvin taylor and the slack band 2003 and rendezvous with the blues 2004 melvin also contributed to two tracks on john mayall s 2022 grammy nominated album the sun is shining down melvin is currently working on his new album coming out in 2027 grab dinner before the show at babygold barbecue link to restaurant website or enjoy full service dining inside the club when doors open parking there is rather limited street parking in the area we recommend arriving by push puppets bring their dual vocal attack to fitzgerald s sidebar for a free show their critically acclaimed 2025 release tethered together has drawn comparisons to squeeze nick lowe xtc and ben folds in both the quirky writing and the gloriously polished production push puppets consists of erich specht lead vocals guitar steve frisbie backup vocals guitar kyle magnusson keyboards john william lauler bass and greg essig drums on their fourth album rdquo tethered together erich muses on relationships and loss as well as the weight and joy of life in a manner effortlessly poetic and married to the track like puzzle pieces wearing his vulnerabilities like a badge of honor this music takes us on a journey to unexpected places push puppets videos on youtube in support of the album have drawn the band thousands of subscribers and hundreds of thousands of video views two of their videos are currently under consideration for the berlin video music awards push puppets continue to churn out pop rock would be classics as they work on the fifth push puppets album which will be released in 2027 here s what critics are saying about tethered together rdquo push puppets know how to make music that is vaguely familiar and brilliantly original in short they create songs that already feel like classics this is certainly one of those times dave franklin the big takeover rdquo events.name: HENRY CARPENDER live in the SIDEBAR!
events.searchText: henry carpender live in the sidebar fitzgeralds sidebar presents henry carpender quintet free show reservation available henry carpender is a trombonist composer and educator based in the city of chicago an artist who is equally informed by his classical training love of jazz and childhood playing rock music primarily with his father john carpender henry s playing and writing is a charming blend of punchy sensitive quirky and dripping with love for life and self expression henry s dedication to music making began at age 13 when he played his first gig with the much beloved local band expo 76 since then through both his education and the beginning of his professional freelance career henry has been fortunate enough to share the stage with dag juhlin billy harper robbie fulks tanya darby cathy richardson nrbq and the canadian brass henry has also enjoyed a healthy start to a career as a private instructor and group music educator running a small studio of dedicated middle and high schoolers across the chicagoland area when he s not playing or teaching he can be found playing video games cooking a new dish or relaxing on montrose beach this show will be an opportunity to premiere new work revisit some favorites and share arrangements of some of henry s favorite artists tommy sagins on drums jack sundstrom on bass aval stanley on keys and special guests abram collier on bari sax voice and ricardo jimenez on trumpet and voice grab dinner before the show at babygold barbecue parking there is rather limited street parking in the area we recommend arriving by rideshare bicycle or rickshaw age restrictions all ages fitzgeralds sidebar berwyn il us

events.name: The Harbour Tour: JON BRYANT at FITZGERALDS Nightclub
events.searchText: the harbour tour jon bryant at fitzgeralds nightclub fitzgeralds nightclub presents the harbour tour jon bryant 20 general admission reserved tables available in an era shaped by artificial intelligence and algorithms jon bryant remains defiantly beautifully human no spectacle no posturing just songs that meet listeners where they are that spirit runs through his forthcoming album harbour a record built on small meaningful details rather than big statements anchored in the unflinching honesty that has defined his work for 15 years harbour was co produced with longtime friend brennan aerts and finds bryant fully recommitting to his folk foundations acoustic instruments clear arrangements and straightforward songwriting written as he prepared to move back to his native nova scotia harbour feels like a homecoming shaped by a major life shift with fatherhood on the horizon the songs move between social reflection and personal reckoning rdquo hard to be human wrestles with disconnection and division rdquo see you thru revisits his brief involvement with nxivm and the instincts it sharpened and rdquo take heart confronts regret and distance from his younger brothers the track features fellow folk artist and longtime friend rose betts whose ethereal vocals add a gentle counterpoint across five full length albums and multiple eps bryant has built a career on emotional transparency and an unpretentious approach to making music harbour is the culmination of that return to self an honest roots forward album made with trusted collaborators and a reminder that staying human is still the point grab dinner before the show at babygold barbecue link to restaurant website or enjoy full service dining inside the club when doors open parking there is rather limited street parking in the area we recommend arriving by rideshare bicycle or rickshaw age restrictions 21 minors admitted with guardian fitzgeralds nightclub berwyn il us

events.name: Caroline Rose - Uncle Carols World of Fun Tour
events.searchText: caroline rose uncle carols world of fun tour fishtailing across a trimmed sod lawn the parking lot of a box store strip mall a fast food drive thru it s a hyperreal americana fantasy that calls caroline rose she they home on gentling the horse at the walt whitman mall the release doubles as the debut of suck records the la based artist s own imprint a fitting next form for an enigmatic musician whose work resists settling into one shape gentling the horse at the walt whitman mall stretches the ordinary into the uncanny the record pairs sharply observed memoiristic songwriting with expansive guitar textures that render the everyday with violent clarity and mythic scale beneath its melodic sweep and signature hooks runs a current of violence and american dream leakage it s ennio morricone with an ar15 surf guitars spaghetti westerns and suburban dread colliding until they become their own sharp vernacular reality is unstable so we ll keep telling stories and for rose the sinister slickness of the everyday grows a new head working with producer john congleton rose built the record through humor layering and instinct rather than polish songs like rdquo conversations with shiv rdquo goddamn train and rdquo everything in its right place were recorded in studio for the first time with sessions that prized first impulses over perfection the result is panoramic but never precious songs that feel meticulously constructed while always threatening to mutate over the last six years rose s music has evolved alongside their work organizing around stronger labor protections and collective bargaining rights for musicians and crews creative and political practice have increasingly become the same project as rose s career has taken on its hyper independent form those concerns echo throughout gentling the horse its landscapes are populated by inherited systems that feel absurd yet inescapable where humor becomes a survival tactic and satire reveals the quiet violence embedded in everyday american life thalia hall chicago il us caroline rose

show taking tangents which promises to do exactly that leaving dublin ireland where he was born and raised until the age of 22 david got drunk on travel and never quite hit sobriety of it he has lived and worked in twelve countries and visited over eighty his shows draw on his wide travels cultural observations attempts at language study occasional international drinking session s and being a mildly confused immigrant david is the winner of the prestigious annual san francisco comedy competition previous finalists include robin williams ellen degeneres and dana carvey and runner up in the events.name: Boots & Biel
events.searchText: boots biel join lauren biel for a one of a kind night of books dancing shopping and fun whether you re a seasoned dancer or have never stepped onto the dance floor before our beginner friendly line dance instruction will have you learning new moves and dancing with confidence in no time no experience required just come ready to have fun this isn t your typical author signing while exclusive lauren biel books will be available for preorder and event pickup all books will be pre signed and will not be sold at the event the goal of the evening isn t to spend time waiting in a signing line it s to create an experience where readers can relax connect dance laugh and genuinely spend time together a professional photographer will also be on site throughout the event giving attendees opportunities to capture photos with lauren and friends while making memories together looking to upgrade your style visit the hat bar to create a custom hat or add leather branding to a hat you already own additional purchase required enjoy specialty drinks at the cash bar mingle with fellow readers and dancers shop with a featured bookish vendor and participate in
